description: Search the Muralists directory of muralists and street artists by free text (name, city, style). Returns matching artists with their profile URLs. Use fetch with a returned id to read the full profile.

query.description: Free-text search query, e.g. 'lettering artist Utrecht'.

name: search

id.description: Pass to fetch to read the full profile.

url.description: Absolute canonical URL of the profile page.

title: Search the Muralists directory
